text: Of obstacles, and as we said, we might have fixed obstacles, and we might have variable obstacles. That may be cars, people passing by, but also the trees. For example, they are mobile and they are obstacles for our signal. So we had, for example, evidence of that in some experiments that we ran in Turin. In winter and in spring, in winter the signal was propagating very well. We were outdoor because trees didn't have any leaves, and in spring the signal was propagating much much worse because the trees had lots of leaves. So sometimes are these small things, but they have an impact on the quality of the received signal. And now we stop for five minutes, and then we see better how obstacles can impact the quality of our signal.
